BEGIN;

-- This is an external catalog identity, not a foreign key into the student DB.
-- Existing rows remain null and use the compatibility live-context fallback.
ALTER TABLE student_practice_task
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS practice_task_revision_id uuid NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_practice_task_revision
    ON student_practice_task(practice_task_revision_id)
    WHERE practice_task_revision_id IS NOT NULL;

COMMIT;
